text:
**Finding:** Auth header stripped on redirect.

- Endpoint: `POST/GET https://app.example.com/api/admin/export`
- Behavior: 302 → `/login?next=%2Fapi%2Fadmin%2Fexport`; `Authorization` header not forwarded post-redirect
- Console error: `"Authorization header missing after redirect replay"`
- Clue: `next` param preserved in redirect URL — test auth bypass by hitting `/api/admin/export` directly with valid token, bypassing redirect logic

**Next:** Replay direct request to `/api/admin/export` with `Authorization` header; verify if server enforces auth pre-redirect or only checks session cookie.
